principles: Money-path code is verified against an independent source of truth, never only against tests written by the same author against the same misunderstanding
A verification category exists only if a public issue owns its executable evidence; the check fails an unowned category rather than tolerating a promise
Numbers live here and nowhere else: harnesses read the floors, ceilings and budgets from this file and never restate them
Test data is synthetic only; production data never reaches any lower environment
Flaky tests are quarantined and fixed, never retried into green

categories.name: Deterministic unit tests
categories.approach: Deterministic unit tests on every change, run by the native CI job of each repository; no network, no wall clock and no unseeded randomness
categories.evidence: The repository's native CI check on the pull request head; per-package line and branch coverage compared with the floors in this file on every run

categories.name: Property-based ledger invariants
categories.approach: Property-based tests over shared generators; the zero-sum invariant, non-negativity where required, rounding and period-boundary rules are machine-checked on generated cases
categories.evidence: Property suite in the api pull request gate; a planted rounding error fails the build and names the falsifying case

categories.name: Independent-model verification of debt maths
categories.approach: Every debt, budgeting and allocation result is compared with a second, independently written implementation across the full case matrix, in addition to mutation testing of the production packages
categories.evidence: Oracle comparison report per run; any disagreement fails the api build and names the case

categories.name: Mutation testing on money paths
categories.approach: Mutation score measured per package by the gate in the repository that owns the package (the api harness for api packages, the Android gate for android.ledger and android.parsers) and compared with the mutation floor published for that package in this file; every money-path package has one
categories.evidence: Per-package mutation score published on every run against its floor; a score below the floor fails the build

categories.name: Parser golden corpus
categories.approach: Golden-corpus regression: every newly observed bank or wallet format becomes a permanent synthetic, structurally faithful case; the corpus is privacy-scanned, versioned and published with coverage by issuer
categories.evidence: Full-corpus run on every parser change with coverage by issuer and rule version published; a regression or a planted identifier in the corpus fails the merge

categories.name: API contract tests
categories.approach: Provider verification that the running service satisfies the published OpenAPI specification, with additive-versus-breaking classification of every change
categories.evidence: Provider verification on the api pull request against the published contract artifact; a removed field fails unless the expand-and-contract protocol was followed

categories.name: Provider and consumer contract testing
categories.approach: Consumer verification of the generated Kotlin, TypeScript and Python clients against the published artifact, with a compatibility report naming each consumer and its verified contract version
categories.evidence: Compatibility report per contract version naming every consumer; a drifting consumer fails its own pipeline

categories.name: Service integration tests
categories.approach: Service tests against a real PostgreSQL instance from the idempotent local bootstrap, exercising database policies and migrations directly
categories.evidence: Integration job in the api pull request gate using the bootstrap database; a failure names the service and the query

categories.name: Android unit and instrumented journeys
categories.approach: Unit tests plus instrumented critical journeys on the device matrix in this file: the API 31, current-release and large-text emulator lanes are required on every pull request and the TalkBack, low-memory, OEM and physical lanes at release candidate, once the Android gate wires them; no emulator lane runs in android CI at publication
categories.evidence: Instrumented results per lane on the pull request and the release candidate; a failing lane is reported by lane and blocks

categories.name: Web end-to-end journeys
categories.approach: Playwright end-to-end tests of the critical journeys (login, transaction entry, payoff view, import, export) against a seeded synthetic environment on latest-stable Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
categories.evidence: Journey suite per engine on the web pull request; a browser-specific failure is reported by engine and blocks

categories.name: Admin operator journeys
categories.approach: Playwright operator journeys (search, redacted read, unmask request, four-eyes approval, support-verified action) with a planted-defect gate proving that weakened redaction, an unmask without a verified ticket and a self-approval each fail
categories.evidence: Operator journey suite and planted-defect results on the admin pull request; a planted defect that passes fails the suite

categories.name: Accessibility conformance
categories.approach: WCAG 2.2 AA on web and admin: a named, pinned WCAG-tagged automated ruleset with zero violations at any impact level for rules tagged WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 Level A and AA on the core journeys (best-practice rules that are not WCAG success criteria are advisory; an exception requires a recorded reason and an expiry on the pull request), run in every browser configuration in this file, plus keyboard-only and screen-reader walkthroughs; Android runs Accessibility Test Framework checks in the instrumented suite and Android Lint accessibility rules with pinned versions, meets the Material accessibility baseline and every applicable WCAG 2.2 AA outcome, and is walked through with TalkBack and Switch Access; every applicable client state taxonomy state on each core journey is asserted against client-state-taxonomy section 8 (announced once with the published politeness, focus target, no re-announcement on return, recovery action reachable by keyboard and switch, disabled controls exposing their reason)
categories.evidence: Automated scan with zero violations at any impact level for WCAG-tagged Level A and AA rules on core journeys in every browser configuration, Android Accessibility Test Framework and Lint results, and attached walkthrough evidence per release covering every applicable taxonomy state; a planted unlabeled control, undersized target, contrast failure, unannounced state or focus that does not move on an error fails the gate

categories.name: Performance budgets
categories.approach: The numeric budgets published in this file are enforced per pull request and per release candidate; a deliberate regression must fail
categories.evidence: Measured value against its budget on every run; a regressed budget fails the pull request or the release candidate

categories.name: Security negative tests
categories.approach: Tests that actively attempt violations from inside the code and against the running service: cross-tenant reads, broken object authorization, mass assignment, authentication bypass and token replay; entitlement tampering by a client claiming a feature its plan lacks, with absence of an entitlement denying per gated feature; rate limiting, lockout and credential stuffing; step-up bypass and step-up token replay on export, deletion and sharing invitations; sharing-grant default deny with absent or expired grants, aggregate-versus-detail separation and differencing attacks; plus the AI request-forgery and operator red-team suites
categories.evidence: Attack suite and object-level authorization coverage report on every api, ai-service and admin pull request, with a negative test per gated feature and per grant scope, and throttling, lockout and step-up replay attempts rejected and audited; a deliberately weakened fixture must make the suite fail

categories.name: Log and evidence redaction gate
categories.approach: Structured logging with a published field allowlist; a static rule that fails the build when a money or personal-data type is logged; a runtime scan of sampled emitted records in CI with a planted money value; fail-closed scrubbing that drops a record rather than emitting it raw, on error paths and exception messages as well as the happy path; failure screenshots and recorded evidence artifacts scrubbed of money values, raw message text and personal data before upload
categories.evidence: Static rule and runtime scan results on every api pull request, and scrubbed-artifact confirmation in each client gate; a planted money value in an emitted record or an uploaded artifact fails the pipeline

categories.name: Static analysis, dependency and secret gates
categories.approach: Static application security testing per language, dependency review with an expiring exception process, full-history secret scanning and the SDK allowlist, all blocking
categories.evidence: Blocking checks on every pull request; a planted injection pattern, advisory or secret fails, and a secret triggers a rotation ticket

categories.name: Security regression smoke in the deploy pipeline
categories.approach: Dynamic scanning of the ephemeral deployed build for the authenticated and unauthenticated surface, plus signed-artifact and provenance verification before deployment
categories.evidence: Dynamic scan report and artifact verification result attached to each deployment; a high-severity finding or an unsigned or tampered artifact fails the deploy gate

categories.name: Supply-chain verification
categories.approach: Infrastructure-as-code policy scanning, container image scanning before publication and deployment, Android release static analysis, a CycloneDX bill of materials per artifact and signed provenance
categories.evidence: Per-artifact bill of materials and provenance linked from the release record; a planted misconfiguration, vulnerable image or insecure Android fixture fails

categories.name: Load, stress and soak
categories.approach: Load profiles at realistic peak against the latency and error budgets in this file, a stress run to the breaking point that records the failure mode, and a sustained soak asserting no memory or connection growth and exact quota counters
categories.evidence: Dated run results against the budgets attached to the release candidate; a regression fails the release

categories.name: Chaos and fault injection
categories.approach: Injected database failover, key-service outage, cache loss, provider outage and webhook storms, each with a defined expected behaviour; a key-service outage must never corrupt or expose data
categories.evidence: Per-fault observed-versus-expected behaviour report per release candidate; an undefined or violated behaviour fails

categories.name: Disaster-recovery restore drills
categories.approach: A performed restore into a clean environment with measured recovery point and recovery time, a timed game day against the objectives in this file, and proof that user erasure survives restore
categories.evidence: Dated drill and game-day records with measured recovery point and time against the targets; the runbook correction is part of the record

categories.name: Privacy traffic inspection
categories.approach: Every release candidate runs its core journeys through an intercepting proxy; the capture must contain no raw message text, no monetary value in analytics and no host outside the allowlist shared with the payload-scrubbing hook
categories.evidence: Signed evidence pack per release candidate consumed by the Data Safety declaration; a planted raw string, monetary value or unknown host fails the release

categories.name: Billing and webhook adversarial replay
categories.approach: Webhook signature verification and idempotent processing plus an adversarial replay and forgery suite across purchase, renewal, refund and entitlement transitions, with nightly reconciliation against the provider
categories.evidence: Replay and forgery suite in the api pull request gate and a nightly drift alarm; a replayed or forged event must produce no second effect

categories.name: Model evaluation in continuous integration
categories.approach: Grounding, refusal, advice-boundary, numeric-fidelity and prompt-injection evaluations against a governed synthetic corpus with the accuracy floor in this file and pinned provider model versions
categories.evidence: Evaluation report per pull request and on any model version change; a score below the floor or an altered number fails the merge

categories.name: STRIDE threat-model refresh
categories.approach: A dated per-epic STRIDE refresh with a named owner before the epic's first ticket starts, covering the ingestion boundary, raw-content-never-leaves-device and the parser-config signing chain as well as application-layer risks, recorded machine-readably
categories.evidence: Refresh record per epic checked at Definition of Ready and in independent review; a stale or incomplete refresh is reported as invalid

categories.name: Independent penetration test
categories.approach: Independent external test scoped from the current threat model with every high and critical finding closed and retested; accepted risks carry an owner and an expiry
categories.evidence: Report, retest records and the accepted-risk register read by the public-launch gate; an open high finding or an expired accepted risk fails the gate

categories.name: Flaky-test quarantine
categories.approach: Quarantine and fix, never silently retry into green: the numbers in this file bound automatic re-execution, trigger quarantine, cap the quarantine rate and age quarantined tests out
categories.evidence: Per-repository flake rate, quarantine list with owning tickets and retry counts published on every run; an exceeded ceiling fails the pipeline

categories.name: Client state coverage
categories.approach: Every registered surface handles every applicable identifier of the published client state taxonomy with the canonical copy and exactly one recovery action, proven with a planted omission (taxonomy coverage assertion client_state_coverage)
categories.evidence: Coverage assertion in each client gate against the taxonomy data file at the pinned taxonomy_version, extended with the section 8 semantics assertion for each rendered state (announced once, focus target, no re-announcement on return, recovery action operable by keyboard and switch); a planted omission or an unannounced state fails

categories.name: Client state taxonomy first
categories.approach: The client's state enumeration is a subset of the identifiers in the taxonomy data file at the pinned taxonomy_version; a new state is added to the taxonomy first and only then to any client (taxonomy coverage assertion taxonomy_first)
categories.evidence: Subset assertion in each client gate against the identifiers at the pinned taxonomy_version; a planted unlisted identifier fails

categories.name: Internationalization checks
categories.approach: Locale-aware INR formatting, a pseudo-localization run over every core journey, and long-string and right-to-left layout safety; single-currency MVP, multi-currency not claimed
categories.evidence: Formatting, pseudo-localization and layout checks in the client gates; a hardcoded symbol, grouping or clipped label fails

categories.name: Insider-risk control checks
categories.approach: A planted-defect gate on redaction, unmask and four-eyes operator journeys plus the operator red-team suite as a blocking console release gate
categories.evidence: Planted-defect and red-team results per admin release; a planted defect that passes fails the release

categories.name: Release rollback rehearsal
categories.approach: A rehearsed, dated deploy rollback and a rehearsed staged-rollout halt with a minimum supported version policy
categories.evidence: Dated rollback and halt rehearsal records read by the release evidence gates; a missing or stale record fails the gate

categories.name: Android release gate
categories.approach: Play App Signing custody, track promotion and a staged rollout that halts on the crash and ANR budgets published in this file
categories.evidence: Vitals measurements against the budgets per rollout stage; a breach halts promotion

categories.name: Compliance reconciliation
categories.approach: Obligation and risk matrices reconciled against the issue inventory, and versioned jurisdiction profiles that fail closed when a statutory value is missing
categories.evidence: Reconciliation run per compliance pack version; an unowned obligation or an unknown ticket fails

categories.name: Design-to-code regression
categories.approach: Visual, interaction and semantic regression against the design source plus cross-platform parity and release design QA
categories.evidence: Regression and parity reports per client release; an unreviewed divergence fails design QA

categories.name: Release evidence gates
categories.approach: Executable private-beta and public-launch gates read the named evidence artifact of every contributing category within the freshness window and fail naming the missing item and its owner; no manual override
categories.evidence: Gate run output naming each artifact, its age and its verdict; a missing, stale or failing artifact fails

categories.name: Strategy reconciliation
categories.approach: The check in this repository reconciles every category, deliverable, device lane and fixture family with an owning public issue and every named package with its numbers, and is re-run at each cadence trigger
categories.evidence: python scripts/check_test_strategy.py in the docs CI job and its unit tests; an unowned category, a dangling identifier or a package without a number fails

floor_policy.unlisted_package_rule: A package present in a repository build but absent from this inventory fails that repository's harness; a package listed here without a line, branch or (on money paths) mutation number fails this check. Neither case is an exemption.
floor_policy.renaming_rule: Renaming, adding or removing a package is a pull request to this file with Core and QA review; the harness never infers a floor for an unknown name.
floor_policy.mutation_enforcement_rule: Every repository that carries a money-path package must have a mutation_testing owner in that repository; a repository without one is recorded here as an enforcement gap with its packages, a reason and a resolution, and its floors stand as requirements that no harness is yet chartered to enforce.

flake_policy.retry_semantics: One automatic re-execution is allowed only to classify a failure: a pass on re-execution is recorded as a flake event against the test and counts towards quarantine, never as a clean pass; the money-path change class gets no re-execution at all
flake_policy.on_quarantine_ceiling_exceeded: The repository's pipeline fails for every change except fixes to quarantined tests until the rate is back under the ceiling
flake_policy.on_retry_limit_exceeded: A pipeline step configured to retry beyond the limit fails the pipeline configuration check; a test that still fails after the permitted re-execution is a real failure and blocks
flake_policy.on_quarantine_expired: A test quarantined for longer than the maximum age fails the build until it is fixed, or deleted with recorded reviewer approval on its owning ticket

pipeline_budgets.on_exceeded: Exceeding a pipeline budget fails the run rather than warning, so a slow harness cannot be disabled for speed

definition_of_ready.text: Acceptance criteria are testable and name the verification categories mandatory for the ticket's change class
Dependencies identified and unblocked in the issue graph; no historical Done status is treated as current acceptance
Estimated below the split threshold, with component and phase assigned
Design and decision records settled where the ticket touches an architectural decision; open decisions are consumed, never guessed

A dated STRIDE threat-model refresh for the epic with a named owner, explicitly covering the ingestion boundary, raw content never leaving the device and the parser-config signing chain as well as application-layer risks

A privacy payload review for the epic: every outbound payload and analytics event the epic adds is classified against the shared allowlist, and the categories that need traffic inspection rather than code review are named
The fixture families the ticket reuses or extends are named; no new ungoverned test data
For the first ticket of an epic: the issue inventory snapshot has been refreshed and the strategy check passes

definition_of_done.text: Acceptance criteria demonstrably met, with evidence named according to the evidence rules
Every category mandatory for the change class has a recorded pass signal on the merged head
Line and branch coverage of every touched package meet the published floors, and money-path coverage did not decline
Mutation score of every touched money-path package meets its published floor
No test was retried beyond the published limit, no quarantine was added without an owning ticket, and no quarantined test was deleted without recorded approval
Separate non-author Core review, QA for behaviour changes and the affected specialists recorded with session, reviewed commit and findings; no substantive finding unresolved
No secret, production data, raw message content or real financial record introduced; dependency additions reviewed against the SDK policy
Money paths use integer minor units with currency, verified by a test rather than assumed
Documents, decision records and this strategy's data updated when behaviour, a decision or a published number changed
Observability in place for anything user-facing or failure-prone, including per-run publication of coverage, mutation score, flake rate and retry count against their floors

review_cadence.change_control: Any change to this data file is a pull request with Core and QA review; a floor, ceiling or budget may only be relaxed with a recorded reason and an expiry on the pull request

not_asserted: No harness, gate, coverage, mutation, accessibility, load or device result is claimed by this file; every number is a requirement its owning issue must meet, and the check proves ownership and shape, not execution
